reason: A uses spatially resolved phase, grain-boundary, and defect descriptors that can plausibly vary among HfNbTiVAl10 heterostructures and affect deformation and cracking, with quantitative accuracy/runtime thresholds and a direct independent-test benchmark. B miscasts composition-weighted elemental-property variances as spatial heterostructure metrics—largely invariant at fixed composition—and proposes obtaining local modulus and dislocation parameters using SEM/XRD/EDS, which cannot directly provide them; its cited evidence also does not validate this alloy-specific mechanism.
